text:
Rory Kim: quick postmortem follow-up — we need concrete owners + timelines for the public status page blurb and the external incident summary. can folks take ownership?
Anika Shah: I can take the status page blurb. suggest publishing a brief note within 6h and a more detailed external post within 4 business days.
Carlos Rivera: ok for timelines. i'll own the impacted-customer list. preliminary export from analytics should be possible in 1bd, confirmed list in 4bd.
Elaine Park: legal flag: if the summary references any customer-specific SLA breaches or invoices, run the outreach language by me before sending. public RCA excerpts must be sanitized.
Maya Chen: thanks. also want the external summary to include a short "recurring pattern" paragraph per the PM so customers know this isn't a one-off. Dan added suggestions in the doc.
Rory Kim: action list i'm proposing:
- Status page short notice (<=6h) -> owner: Anika
- Draft external summary w/ mitigation roadmap (4bd) -> owner: Rory
- Impacted customer preliminary list (1bd) & confirm list (4bd) -> owner: Carlos
- Legal/comms review + outreach language (3bd) -> owner: Elaine
- Internal remediation tracker/Jira tasks completed -> owner: Maya
Anika Shah: status page draft below, please review. will wait for a quick ack before publishing:
```
[Major] 2026-07-21 11:42 UTC: Generation endpoints experienced intermittent 5xx errors and timeouts.
Impact: ~0.25% of requests returned errors during the window; some Dedicated customers saw elevated latency.
Action: We applied routing fixes and temporary fallbacks. A follow-up summary with next steps will be published within 4 business days.
```
Carlos Rivera: looks good. suggest adding: "Customer support will proactively contact any customers who experienced SLA breaches."
Elaine Park: add that line but change to: "Support will contact customers if their contractual SLAs were impacted; we are not naming customers without consent."
Rory Kim: noted. Carlos — can you produce the preliminary impacted list by EOD tomorrow?
Carlos Rivera: yes — preliminary list by EOD tomorrow. i'll include deployment type, region, and approximate error rates per customer.
Maya Chen: i'll create the Jira subtasks for outreach + remediation and tag owners. target to have tasks linked in the external summary before publishing.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0721 logged. Reminder set: external-summary-due-4bd -> 1790951355
Anika Shah: ack — i'll post the status page update once Elaine gives a quick signoff on the language.
Elaine Park: i'll do a cursory review in 2h and flag any legal-sensitive phrasing. for the sanitized RCA excerpt, i'll post the public template in #comms-templates.
Rory Kim: thanks team. i'll draft the recurring-patterns paragraph and mitigation timeline and put it in this thread for Elaine's review by EOD. let's reconvene here if anything slips. :rocket:
